metadata.description: Cross-platform Agent Skill for preliminary Japanese land brokerage valuation support. Local-first, Apache-2.0, white-box calculation support for user-provided MLIT transaction and L01 land-price-publication data.

plugins.name: tochi-satei-kun
plugins.description: Adds the tochi-satei-kun Agent Skill for preliminary Japanese land brokerage valuation support. It runs the canonical local Python engine and generates Excel and JSON outputs; outputs are not real-estate appraisal opinions.

author.name: Koichi Matsuda (Licensed Real Estate Appraiser, Japan, 2002-)
